'''Zak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Separatist War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was backing the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|Mantellian Government]]. He resided in [[Oradam village]] with his wife, [[Jaller]] when they were poisoned by a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb|bomb's]] radiation, the same powerful bomb the Separatists had stolen from the Republic. He and his wife traveled to [[Fort Garnik]] to ask for supplies but the Republic troopers refused giving any assistance, ignoring the intel Zak wanted to exchange. Eventually a Republic [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] found the wounded couple and accepted to exchange medical supplies for Zak's information.
